Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/recent_drop.rs:173`: The PR changes the visible File Open menu, but its body has no before/after screenshots. Add both screenshots to the PR body. Show the original menu and the new example submenu. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not add them to the PR branch.

No other blocking findings.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The requested screenshots are now in the PR body.
The before image shows the original File Open menu.
The after image shows the open example submenu and its project list.
Both images are stored only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch, commit `8ab1c77c1f9dd717b930da09dfa82ff7f4d24b00`.
I checked both captures from the actual shell renderer.

This finding required no code change or new test pin. A mutation check does not apply to the image links.
The quick gate passed: 983 tests passed, 7 were ignored, and none failed.
UI clippy passed with all targets and warnings denied.

Current PR head: `8c48203a3d5441d49df84f36235bc983e9540771` (unchanged).
The PR remains a draft. Please re-review the screenshot finding.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 8c48203a3d5441d49df84f36235bc983e9540771 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a review of the new evidence on the same head. The later author comment answers the earlier screenshot finding.
I opened both image links in the PR body. The before image shows the original File Open menu.
The after image shows "Open example" and its project list. Both images use the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.
The screenshot finding is resolved. I withdraw that earlier request.

The example list uses the existing project-open command and its unsaved-work guard.
The tests cover file selection, name order, directory absence, browser exclusion, and the empty list.
The PR does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry.
No goldens changed. This is not a safety-tier review. I did not run mutations.

I tested locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2059` after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `780b0a25a40606dc3cc96f56ab0b2c8ecb1093e6`.
No GitHub runner was used.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only ui` passed.
The uncommitted trial merge makes the gate plan include changes from main. I selected only the UI step, which covers this PR.
The step built and ran the UI library and 17 integration suites from `crates/ui`.

Clippy results:

- PR head alone: `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- Trial merge: the same command failed on the unused constant below.
- Main alone: `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --lib -- -D warnings` failed on the same constant.

```text
error: constant `MIN_LABEL_PX` is never used
   --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/painted.rs:115:11
115 | pub const MIN_LABEL_PX: f32 = 10.0;
    = note: `-D dead-code` implied by `-D warnings`
```

This is an existing main failure. The PR does not change that file. It is not a blocker for this PR.
Native window interaction, browser compilation, and an installed release package were not tested.
Filesystem permission errors and failure to locate the executable were not tested.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
